# 退款政策

订单签收后七天内可以申请退款。退款申请必须由订单本人提交，并提供对应订单号。

# 物流政策

标准配送通常需要三个工作日。订单发货后，客户可以在订单详情中查看物流节点。

# Return Policy

Customers may request a refund within seven days after delivery. The request must be submitted by the order owner.

# Shipping Policy

Standard delivery usually takes three business days. Shipment progress is available from the order details page.
